tldr: Sun through the 9th house brings focus to travel, study, belief, publishing, law, and spiritual perspective.
body: Sun transiting the 9th house illuminates travel, study, belief, publishing, law, and spiritual perspective. For about a month, attention, vitality, and conscious focus move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a visibility transit: it shows where your life force wants to be recognized, strengthened, and chosen consciously.
business: Sun supports learning, teaching, and widening the view: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Ego inflation, overexposure, or using certainty to avoid humility.
advice: Use the spotlight in the 9th house deliberately. Work with travel, study, belief, publishing, law, and spiritual perspective without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
